name: Queues & Event-Driven Processing
description: Queues & Event-Driven Processing standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-QUEUE applies.

rules.title: Assume at-least-once delivery unless the broker guarantees otherwise
rules.detail: Consumers must tolerate duplicates through idempotency or deduplication for side-effecting handlers.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Assume at-least-once delivery unless the broker guarantees otherwise.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Assume at-least-once delivery unless the broker guarantees otherwise.

rules.title: Define message contract and versioning
rules.detail: Messages have stable type/schema identifiers and evolve additively with producer/consumer compatibility.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define message contract and versioning.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define message contract and versioning.

rules.title: Acknowledge only after durable successful processing
rules.detail: Do not remove a message before required business state is safely committed.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Acknowledge only after durable successful processing.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Acknowledge only after durable successful processing.

rules.title: Use bounded retries and dead-letter queues
rules.detail: Poison messages must not loop forever; capture reason, attempts and a recovery/replay workflow.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use bounded retries and dead-letter queues.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use bounded retries and dead-letter queues.

rules.title: Control ordering and concurrency intentionally
rules.detail: Partition/ordering key and consumer parallelism match business ordering requirements rather than relying on accidental broker behavior.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Control ordering and concurrency intentionally.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Control ordering and concurrency intentionally.

rules.title: Propagate correlation and trace context
rules.detail: Messages include correlation/causation metadata so distributed flows can be traced without embedding secrets.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Propagate correlation and trace context.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Propagate correlation and trace context.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-QUEUE applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Queues & Event-Driven Processing to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Queues & Event-Driven Processing is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Queues & Event-Driven Processing failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
